# rollout

> Reinforcement learning for language-model agents, from one GPU to a cluster. A uv workspace of Python 3.13
> packages: `rollout` (tasks, agents, programs, a loop that runs episodes), `rollout-train` (episode runners,
> episodes with token trajectories, the training loop and its objectives, checkpoints and the ledger, evals, channels,
> the gateway that records every turn, bridges, the cluster config and run settings, runs built from their settings
> and submitted as jobs, the `rollout` command, the monitor), one package per implementation (a vLLM engine, LoRA and
> full-weight trainers, Tinker's trainer and engine, Qwen and Gemma renderers, an OpenAI endpoint, an S3 blob store,
> RunPod pods) and three environments. A Helm chart deploys it on Kubernetes. The documentation describes the code as
> built; design notes say their status at the top.

Conventions: hooks and tools are `async`; everything leaving task or agent code goes through `run`; contract types
are frozen pydantic models; type names are never abbreviated. In `docs/guide/`, a block tagged exactly `python` runs
in the test suite and a block tagged `py` does not. The API reference is generated from the source. Every page opens
with what it covers and who it is for, then "Read first" and "Next" links.

## Start here

- [Documentation home](docs/README.md): the sections by what the reader wants to do, the packages, the conventions
- [Start here](docs/start/README.md): what rollout does, the main ideas (environment, episode, run, checkpoint,
  channel, gateway, ledger, suite), how they work together, where to go next
- [Three ways in](docs/guide/perspectives.md): the surface for building an environment, for designing training, and
  for deploying
- [Architecture](docs/architecture/overview.md): layers, protocols and their implementations, visibility, a turn

## Write an environment

- [Write an environment](docs/guide/README.md): the section's reading order, its ideas, where each name lives
- [Run a first episode](docs/guide/getting-started.md): install, a first task, one episode against a scripted model
- [Write a task](docs/guide/tasks.md): hooks, observations, endings, validation rules, rewards, more model slots
- [Give the model tools](docs/guide/tools.md): `@tool` methods, schemas from type hints, results, errors as
  observations, imported tool sets
- [Choose what the model sees](docs/guide/agents.md): context selection, context hints, acting, the `Model` interface
- [Messages, files and digests](docs/guide/content.md): messages, blocks, tool results, blobs (files or S3), digests
- [What a run records](docs/guide/runs-and-events.md): `LocalRunContext`, effect identity, run events, the local
  runner
- [Use a hosted model](docs/guide/models.md): binding model slots to the Responses API adapter; Codex login or API key
- [Test with a scripted model](docs/guide/testing.md): `ScriptedModelEndpoint` and helpers, checking an environment
- [Import an environment from git](docs/guide/publishing.md): the entry point, dependencies on the platform, what an
  import from git checks, versions
- [The harness](docs/libraries/rollout/README.md): the loop, programs, runners, failures
- [Sandboxes](docs/libraries/rollout/sandboxes.md): declaring sandboxes, pools, leases, pools over HTTP
- [Determinism](docs/libraries/rollout/determinism.md): time, randomness and effect identity in task code
- [Hooks](docs/libraries/rollout/hooks.md): observers of every run's events and model samples
- [Memory for long episodes](docs/libraries/rollout/memory.md): a context that fits any model
- Example environments: [Minecraft team](docs/products/minecraft-team.md) (one to four agents in a Minecraft world,
  on a curriculum), [Gridworld](docs/products/gridworld.md) (two to four agents share out a grid's plates over chat),
  [Judging](docs/products/judging.md) (open-ended answers scored by a judge against a versioned rubric)

## Train a model

- [Train a model](docs/train/README.md): the section's reading order, choosing a trainer and an objective
- [Episode runners](docs/libraries/rollout-train/rollouts.md): what runs and runners write, claims and fences,
  heartbeats, environments and their train and eval data
- [Episodes](docs/libraries/rollout-train/episodes.md): what a finished run carries for training
- [The training loop and objectives](docs/libraries/rollout-train/training.md): the loop, steps over groups,
  objectives and presets, the curriculum, the trainer protocol, changing settings, pausing and resuming
- [Launch runs](docs/libraries/rollout-train/launching.md): submitting a run's job (a Ray job or a RayJob), the
  launches table, the driver that builds a run from its settings and claims what it needs, what a cluster offers
- [Checkpoints, runs and the ledger](docs/libraries/rollout-train/checkpoints.md): checkpoints, manifests, bridges,
  append-only tables and fences, the registry
- [Datasets and supervised steps](docs/libraries/rollout-train/datasets.md): examples chosen from episodes, SFT steps
- [Channels and engines](docs/libraries/rollout-train/channels.md): engines, limits, what a channel should serve,
  engine hosts, engines elsewhere, sharing a GPU with the trainer
- [Record turns for training](docs/libraries/rollout-train/recorder.md): the thinking budget, segments, renderers
- [The gateway](docs/libraries/rollout-train/gateway.md): a stateless service that samples channels with signed keys
  and records every turn in the ledger and the blob store
- [Train any harness over HTTP](docs/libraries/rollout-train/harness-endpoint.md): the gateway's OpenAI and
  Anthropic APIs for harnesses that bring their own loop

## Evaluate a model

- [Evaluate a model](docs/evaluate/README.md): what to read, in order
- [Suites and evals](docs/libraries/rollout-train/evals.md): suites and their versions, evals of checkpoints, evals
  during training

## Deploy the platform

- [Deploy the platform](docs/deploy/README.md): the section's reading order, and the deployment files in the
  repository
- [What runs where](docs/deploy/roles.md): the roles and the CPU, GPU, memory and storage each needs
- [Choose a setup](docs/deploy/setups.md): one machine without Kubernetes, one machine with K3s, several nodes
- [Prepare a Kubernetes cluster](docs/deploy/kubernetes.md): KubeRay, the NVIDIA device plugin and runtime, a storage
  class, an ingress controller, K3s on one machine
- [Build the platform image](docs/deploy/image.md): BuildKit in the cluster, or Docker and CI
- [Install the Helm chart](docs/deploy/helm.md): values, Secrets, the cluster config, ingresses, volumes, installing
  and upgrading (never `--reuse-values`)
- [Share GPUs](docs/deploy/gpus.md): whole cards per Ray worker, time-slicing, memory caps per process
- [Postgres and S3](docs/deploy/stores.md): the stores in the cluster config, and moving a ledger and a blob store
  into them (`rollout ledger copy`, `rollout_s3.copying`, `rollout_train.relocating`)
- [Volumes and backups](docs/deploy/backups.md): reclaim policies, backing up and restoring, uninstalling K3s
- [Ingress, TLS and sign-in](docs/deploy/access.md): host names, TLS, sign-in in front of the monitor, private stores
- [Remote providers](docs/deploy/providers.md): Tinker, RunPod pods over mutual TLS with step-ca, hosted APIs
- [Start runs and evals](docs/deploy/runs.md): after deploying
- [Troubleshooting](docs/deploy/troubleshooting.md): problems seen in real deployments, and their fixes
- [Local Postgres and S3 for development](docs/development/local-services.md): both stores in Docker Compose
- [Deploy with the rollout command](docs/guide/deploying.md): asking for runs and evals from a shell, what a run's
  job starts, engines elsewhere, the gateway and Ray

## Operate the platform

- [Operate the platform](docs/operate/README.md): watching runs, changing them while they go, keeping checkpoints,
  checking the configuration, backups
- [The monitor](docs/libraries/rollout-train/monitor.md): a live page over a ledger and every run in it: steps,
  groups, episodes and every agent's turns, checkpoints, evals, environments, statistics, machines
